# `aitbc wallet multisig-propose`

Propose a multi-signature payment to a destination address.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc wallet multisig-propose [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--wallet` | text | — | yes | Multisig wallet name |
| `--to-address` | text | — | yes | Destination address. |
| `--amount` | decimal | — | yes | Amount of AIT. |
| `--description` | text | — | no | Transaction description |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc wallet multisig-propose --wallet <wallet_name> --to-address <to_address> --amount <amount>
```
